en-US.name: DingTalk API Skill
en-US.summary: DingTalk API scripts. Real queries require Node.js/npm dependencies, DINGTALK_APP_KEY, DINGTALK_APP_SECRET and authorized API permissions. Command startup is not a successful query; platform terms and any fees apply.

zh-CN.name: 钉钉 API 技能
zh-CN.summary: 钉钉 API 脚本。实际查询需自行安装 Node.js/npm 依赖，私下配置 DINGTALK_APP_KEY、DINGTALK_APP_SECRET 并授权接口权限。命令启动不等于查询成功；适用平台条款及可能的费用。

requirements.value: Node.js/npm, TypeScript/ts-node and the dependencies declared by the pinned package.json, including the Alibaba Cloud DingTalk SDK. The packaged scripts/search-user.ts exists and validates configuration before requesting an access token or performing a query.

Real searches require DINGTALK_APP_KEY and DINGTALK_APP_SECRET from an operator-authorized DingTalk application, plus the corresponding API scopes and account access. Configure credentials privately on the host; do not paste them into chat or this catalog. Missing credentials produce MISSING_CREDENTIALS and exit before a query. Startup/help is not proof of a successful query; no authenticated query was verified. DingTalk terms, entitlements and any fees apply separately.
